subject: FedRAMP & ISO convergence — evidence triage, mapping, and audit window
messages:
From: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@clearwaterbank.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearwaterbank.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: FedRAMP & ISO evidence overlap and upcoming audit window

David —

Thanks for the earlier call. As we prep our procurement packet I wanted to confirm two things quickly so we can lock the audit window with our compliance team:  

1) Can you share a concise mapping that shows which ISO 27001 controls Redwood will use as primary evidence for the FedRAMP scoping exercise? We only need a high-level crosswalk for now (control ID -> artifact type & owner).

2) We have a tentative audit window the week of Sep 18th (US East). Is that feasible on your end for a readout / evidence review with BrightAudit? If not, please propose two alternative weeks.

Also, any anticipated gaps (logs, key management narratives, operator access evidence) that we should surface to our sign-off committee would be helpful. 

Thanks — appreciate a short reply so we can close scheduling.

Sarah Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Clearwater Bank
[Attachment: procurement_requirements_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@clearwaterbank.com>, BrightAudit Engagement <engagement@brightaudit.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: FedRAMP & ISO evidence overlap and upcoming audit window

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front:  

1) Yes — we can provide a compact mapping (control -> artifact & owner). Grace will attach a draft crosswalk to this thread; it will include the primary ISO control reference, the typical artifact (policy/log/report), and an internal owner we suggest for evidence pulls.

2) The week of Sep 18th is currently plausible for Redwood. We have a small engineering maintenance window on Sep 20th that might constrain deep-dive sessions in the afternoon. If BrightAudit needs a full-day engagement, please keep Sep 18–19 or the following week Sep 25–29 as options.

Potential gaps to flag (high level):
- Centralized log retention snapshots for multi-tenant demo clusters (we can provide per-customer retention config but need to prepare sampled exports).
- KMS key rotation proof: we have automated rotation logs but will package a short narrative plus rotation job logs for the auditors.
- Third-party attestation matrix for some smaller infra tooling — Karthik will confirm which vendors have PSOs on file.

Action items:
- Grace: attach initial ISO->FedRAMP crosswalk and indicate evidence owners.
- Karthik: confirm vendor attestation list and summarize gaps.
- Monica: propose runbook for evidence delivery (Drive / Console links + expected SLAs).

We aim to share the draft mapping by EOD tomorrow. If that works, Sarah, can you confirm the preferred audit slot (morning/afternoon) and whether auditors prefer a console walkthrough vs. file-based evidence?

Cheers,

— David Kim
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: none in this message]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@clearwaterbank.com>, BrightAudit Engagement <engagement@brightaudit.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: FedRAMP & ISO evidence overlap and upcoming audit window

Hi all —

Attached is the initial crosswalk (condensed to one sheet) that maps ISO 27001 Annex A references to the FedRAMP controls we expect to exercise during your scoping. The sheet includes:
- Control ID (ISO & FedRAMP),
- Typical artifact type (policy, runbook, log export, transcript),
- Suggested Redwood owner,
- Estimated collection effort (low/medium/high),
- Required sampling notes.

Top-level observations:
- ~70% of the required evidentiary artifacts are already represented in our Control Library (policies & runbooks). The remaining ~30% are extractable artifacts (logs, job histories, user lists) that will need scoped sampling for your auditors.
- KMS-related docs: we can produce rotation job logs and KMS key metadata; however, per-customer key proofs for dedicated private installs will require a brief statement from our deployment teams.
- Logging retention: we will provide 90/180-day snapshots depending on the control; we recommend providing auditors with pre-filtered samples to avoid exposing unrelated tenant data.

Attachments included:  
- iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 78KB) — initial crosswalk + owner column
- sig_caiq_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 64KB) — current SIG/CAIQ snapshot for quick reference

Proposed schedule for audit readiness:
- Jul 13: Redwood internal review and finalize crosswalk (Grace + Karthik + Monica).
- Jul 15: Share sanitized samples and Drive access with BrightAudit.
- Jul 22: Dry run / walkthrough with BrightAudit (1.5 hours).
- Sep 18–22: Primary audit window (reserve mornings); Sep 25–29 fallback.

Monica — can you draft the evidence delivery runbook and a checklist for the auditors (what we will provide via Console vs. Drive)? Karthik — please list vendor PSOs by EOD the 13th.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if needed.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Compliance Manager, Red-team Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 78KB)]
[Attachment: sig_caiq_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 64KB)]

Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: FedRAMP & ISO evidence overlap and upcoming audit window

Grace / David —

This is excellent — thank you. The crosswalk looks clean and the owner column is very helpful. We can commit to Sep 18–19 mornings for the primary window; please flag any sessions that must avoid the 20th maintenance slot.

Two quick asks before your dry run:  
- Please mark any artifacts that require tenant-level redaction or that might surface PII. We'll need the sanitized copies ahead of the dry run (by Jul 15) so our legal team can clear them.
- Can BrightAudit confirm whether they prefer a Console walkthrough (screen-share) for policies + runbooks and file uploads for logs? If BrightAudit prefers both, we'll plan for a 90-minute slot.

Once we have the sanitized samples and the runbook, I'll route calendar invites for Sep 18 morning blocks and include the Clearwater security SMEs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Sarah Brooks
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Clearwater Bank
